Name: Returning Player Experience Survey
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40

Event Info:
In order to create a better gaming environment, the Command Central has decided to conduct a survey regarding the in-game experiences of returning players. Please tap the [Advance] button below to share your thoughts! Rewards will be granted upon completion of the survey.

ActivityDes: During the event, commandants in the "Return" state can complete the missions and get the rewards (the event ends when the Return state expires).

Name: Sightline Breach
ActivityDes: Event Info: Play through the new story [Sightline Breach] and complete missions.

Name: Simulated Battlefield
ActivityDes:
Requirement:
Clear Normal Story 2-2 to unlock.

Mission Info:
1. Earn Simulation Scores upon clearing a stage.
2. Spend Simulation Scores to purchase items at the Simulation Shop.
3. The limited-time shop exchange ends on February 2, 2026, at 05:00 (UTC).
4. During the event period, clear Simulated Battlefield stages and consume a certain amount of serum to claim rewards.

Name: Special Dispatch: Wasteland Merchant
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.52

Event Info:
1. Special Dispatch: Wasteland Merchant consists of 4 areas, which will be available over time. Each area consists of various blocks. Clear a block to unlock the adjacent blocks.
2. Consume [Floating Processors] on [Battle] or [Dispatch] to obtain Block Contribution and event token [Trial Prototypes].
3. When there is enough Block Contribution contributed by all the commandants on the server, the block will be cleared and all the commandants will receive the reward and bonuses of the block.
4. This event introduces a new Auction House system. You can clear stages to obtain collectibles and upgrade the Collection Room for rewards; you can also trade collectibles using tokens in the Auction House.
5. Use collectibles to upgrade the Collection Room and light up rare collectibles to receive generous rewards.
6. Clear a block of the designated character to receive the corresponding trial character. The character will also gain a huge boost in battles of the event.
7. Clear the [Dark Block] in the first area to unlock [Phase Results]. Results will be calculated every hour to grant [Trial Prototypes]. With the clearance of the [Dark Blocks] in the areas, the reward granted every hour will get better.
8. Special Supplies: [Trial Prototypes] earned from the event can be exchanged for amazing rewards in the [Special Supplies].

Name: The Godfall Revelation
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40

Event Info:
1. New final chapter story added to Path of Revelation. After completing the stories of Watanabe, Vera, Wanshi, and Lilith, tap any character on the event interface to enter.
2. New stamps and other items added to the permanent shop.
3. Balance adjustments made to character skills, accessories, and runes.

Name: Debugging Frenzy
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40

Event Info:
1. Hack into the code world and complete emergency maintenance.
2. The event consists of 12 stages.
3. Control characters to avoid enemies, repair code blocks, and use specific items to defeat enemies to reclaim stolen code blocks and complete the repair work.
4. Various items will be provided to help you achieve objectives.
5. Beat the designated challenges to complete missions and claim Event Construct R&D Tickets, Trade Vouchers, and other items.

Name: Rapid Pursuit
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.42

Event Info:
1. This event features 4 stages, each with 4 difficulty levels.
2. Defeat Bosses of different difficulties in bounties with the required characters.
3. Complete bounty missions to claim rewards.

Name: Liminal Rift
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40

Event Info:
1. There are a total of 6 difficulty levels, all of which are highly challenging with [The Pseudo-Unwinged] being your formidable enemy.
2. All members will be reset once knocked out during the challenge, making the challenge easier to complete.
3. Each stage has its own 3-star clearance conditions. Collectibles will be rewarded once you have earned a total of 3 stars. The more stars you earn, the higher the quality of the collectibles will be.
